cards.answer: Corki is a marksman/mage who combines basic attacks with explosive abilities. His damage favors AD, with physical damage, bonus true damage on attacks, and magic damage from his bomb and fire trail. Dodge his explosives and move out of his sustained fire.
cards.counterplay: Dodge his explosives and move out of his sustained fire.

cards.answer: Phosphorus Bomb explodes at a target location, dealing magic damage in an area. It grants sight of the impact area and reveals enemy champions hit.
cards.counterplay: Move away from the targeted area; account for the reveal when retreating.

cards.answer: Valkyrie dashes Corki to a target location, leaving a fire trail along his path. Enemies in the fire take repeated magic damage.
cards.counterplay: Leave the fire trail and look for pressure after he uses his dash.

cards.answer: Gatling Gun repeatedly deals physical damage in a cone toward Corki's facing direction. Hits stack armor and magic resistance reduction, and further hits refresh the reduction.
cards.counterplay: Move out of the firing cone and avoid extended trades while your defenses are reduced.

cards.answer: Missile Barrage fires a missile that explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing physical damage in an area. Corki stores missiles over time, and basic attacks against champions accelerate their recharge. Every third missile is a Big One with increased damage, range, and explosion radius.
cards.counterplay: Sidestep missiles, spread out against the explosions, and limit his opportunities to attack champions.
